3) AP contact: we'll route POs and remittance confirms to erin.lowe@cyanhour.com. If invoices come to contracts@cyanhour.com, will you confirm someone there is monitoring for AP?

Next steps on our side: Laura (cc) will open a vendor verification ticket with Ops and create a temporary vendor code so purchases can start once Accounting validates the ACH.
